Detrick Gymnasium]] | champion = NEC regular-season co-champions | tourney = | tourney_result = }} {{2023–24 Northeast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2023–24 Central Connecticut Blue Devils men's basketball team''' represented [[Central Connecticut State University]] during the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Blue Devils, led by third-year head coach [[Patrick Sellers]], played their home games at the [[William H. Detrick Gymnasium]] in [[New Britain, Connecticut]] as members of the [[Northeast Conference]] (NEC). The Blue Devils finished the season 20–11, 13–3 in [[2023–24 Northeast Conference men's basketball season|NEC play]], to finish in a tie for first place.{{Cite web |title=Men's College Basketball Standings - 2023-24 Northeast Conference Standings |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/standings/_/season/2024/group/19 |access-date=2025-03-17 |website=ESPN}} In the [[2024 Northeast Conference men's basketball tournament|NEC tournament]], they defeated [[2023–24 Saint Francis Red Flash men's basketball team|Saint Francis (PA)]] in the quarterfinals{{Cite web |last=Hartman |first=Jason |date=March 7, 2024 |title=CCSU Men's Basketball Wins First Tournament Game Since 2011 |url=https://centralrecorder.org/83824/sports/ccsu-mens-basketball-wins-first-tournament-game-since-2011/ |access-date=2024-11-24 |website=The Recorder}} before falling to [[2023–24 Wagner Seahawks men's basketball team|Wagner]] in the semifinals.{{Cite web |last=Hartman |first=Jason |date=March 10, 2024 |title=Blue Devils Fall In NEC Tournament |url=https://centralrecorder.org/83908/sports/blue-devils-fall-in-nec-tournament/ |access-date=2024-11-24 |website=The Recorder}} ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 Central Connecticut Blue Devils men's basketball team|Blue Devils]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 10–22, 7–9 in [[2022–23 Northeast Conference men's basketball season|NEC play]], to finish in a tie for seventh place.{{Cite news |title=NEC Men's College Basketball Standings - 2022-23 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/standings/_/season/2023/group/19 |access-date=November 27, 2023 |work=ESPN}} They were defeated by [[2022–23 Saint Francis Red Flash men's basketball team|Saint Francis (PA)]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2023 Northeast Conference men's basketball tournament|NEC tournament]].{{Cite news |date=March 1, 2023 |title=Men's Basketball Season Ends at Saint Francis U in NEC Quarterfinals |url=https://ccsubluedevils.com/sports/mbkb/2022-23/releases/20230301wgy12q |access-date=November 27, 2023 |work=Central Connecticut State University Athletics |language=en}} ==Preseason polls== ===Northeast Conference poll=== The Northeast Conference released its preseason coaches' poll on October 24, 2023.
